Good afternoon Rahul,

Sure, we will be happy to arrange the viewing for you.

However, please note that our units are actively listed on multiple online platforms, so we may receive a booking at any time. Therefore, we will confirm the viewing with you on Tuesday, subject to the unit still being available.

Please also note that viewings can only be arranged between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM. Building management does not permit agents to conduct viewings after 6:00 PM, so kindly ensure that the viewing is completed before this time.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
